#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

// Fast I/O
static char buf[1 << 20];
static int pos = 0, len = 0;
inline char getc() {
    if (pos == len) {
        pos = 0;
        len = fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), stdin);
        if (len == 0) return EOF;
    }
    return buf[pos++];
}
inline ll readLong() {
    ll x = 0;
    int c = getc();
    while (c <= ' ') c = getc();
    bool neg = false;
    if (c == '-') { neg = true; c = getc(); }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
        x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        c = getc();
    }
    return neg ? -x : x;
}
inline int readInt() { return (int)readLong(); }

// Sieve of Eratosthenes
vector<int> sieveEratosthenes(int n) {
    if (n < 2) return vector<int>();
    vector<bool> comp(n + 1, false);
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!comp[i]) {
            count++;
            if ((ll)i * i <= n) {
                for (int j = i * i; j <= n; j += i)
                    comp[j] = true;
            }
        }
    }
    vector<int> ret(count);
    int pos = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!comp[i])
            ret[pos++] = i;
    }
    return ret;
}

vector<int> primes = sieveEratosthenes(400000);

class MeisselLehmer2 {
public:
    vector<int> primes;
    vector<int> xcums;
    vector<uint64_t> isp;
    int cachelimit;
    unordered_map<ll, ll> picache;
    unordered_map<ll, ll> phicache;
    bool cachePhi = false;

    vector<vector<int>> cumps;
    vector<int> FP = {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19};
    int M = FP.size();
    int B = 100;

    MeisselLehmer2(ll n) {
        assert(n >= 4);
        int s = (int)sqrt(n) * B;
        cachelimit = s;
        this->primes = sieveEratosthenes(s);
        xcums.assign((s >> 6) + 1, 0);
        isp.assign((s >> 6) + 1, 0);
        for (int p : this->primes)
            isp[p >> 6] |= 1ULL << p;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)xcums.size() - 1; i++)
            xcums[i + 1] = xcums[i] + __builtin_popcountll(isp[i]);

        // Build cumps
        vector<bool> b = {true};
        int len = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            len *= FP[i];
            vector<bool> c(len);
            for (int j = 0; j < FP[i]; j++) {
                copy(b.begin(), b.end(), c.begin() + j * b.size());
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < len; k += FP[i])
                c[k] = false;
            cumps.push_back(vector<int>(len + 1, 0));
            for (int j = 0; j < len; j++)
                cumps[i][j + 1] = cumps[i][j] + (c[j] ? 1 : 0);
            FP[i] = len;
            b = move(c);
        }
    }

    ll sqrt(ll n) {
        ll i = max(0LL, (ll)std::sqrt(n) - 2);
        while (i * i <= n) i++;
        return i - 1;
    }

    ll cbrt(ll n) {
        ll i = max(0LL, (ll)std::cbrt(n) - 2);
        while (i * i * i <= n) i++;
        return i - 1;
    }

    ll pi(ll x) {
        if (x <= cachelimit) {
            int ix = (int)x;
            int block = ix >> 6;
            int bit = ix & 63;
            return xcums[block] + __builtin_popcountll(isp[block] << (63 - bit));
        }
        auto it = picache.find(x);
        if (it != picache.end()) return it->second;

        int A = (int)pi(sqrt(sqrt(x)));
        ll ret = A + phi(x, A) - P2(x, A) - P3(x, A) - 1;
        picache[x] = ret;
        return ret;
    }

    ll phi(ll x, int A) {
        if (A > 0 && A - 1 < M) {
            int idx = A - 1;
            return (ll)cumps[idx][FP[idx]] * (x / FP[idx]) + cumps[idx][(int)(x % FP[idx] + 1)];
        }
        if (A > 0 && x <= (ll)primes[A - 1] * primes[A - 1]) {
            return pi(x) - A + 1;
        }
        ll code = (x << 13) | A;
        auto it = phicache.find(code);
        if (it != phicache.end()) return it->second;

        ll ret = x;
        for (int i = A - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            ret -= phi(x / primes[i], i);

        if (cachePhi)
            phicache[code] = ret;
        return ret;
    }

    ll P2(ll x, int A) {
        int B = (int)pi(sqrt(x));
        ll ret = 0;
        for (int i = A; i < B; i++) {
            ret += pi(x / primes[i]);
        }
        ret -= (ll)(B - A) * (B + A - 1) / 2;
        return ret;
    }

    ll P3(ll x, int A) {
        int C = (int)pi(cbrt(x));
        ll ret = 0;
        for (int i = A; i < C; i++) {
            ll xi = x / primes[i];
            int B = (int)pi(sqrt(xi));
            for (int j = i; j < B; j++) {
                ret += pi(xi / primes[j]) - j;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
};

void solve() {
    ll n = readLong();
    ll ans = 0;
    MeisselLehmer2 ml(n / 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)primes.size(); i++) {
        ll plus = ml.pi(n / primes[i]) - (i + 1);
        if (plus <= 0) break;
        ans += plus;
    }
    for (int p : primes) {
        if ((ll)p * p * p <= n) {
            ans++;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
